name: Kerecsen Szabó
summary: I turn complex business needs into reliable, scalable ML products, combining software engineering depth with production ML and data platform experience. Across 9+ years in software, data and machine learning, I have built forecasting platforms, real-time model-serving systems and distributed data pipelines, working with stakeholders from requirements through deployment and production support. I prioritize clean, performant code and use AI tools to accelerate delivery while reviewing and verifying their output.
ai_native: Use AI tools to boost productivity in drafting and proofreading documentation, rewriting text and generating code; inspect and verify all AI-generated output before use.
Use GitHub Copilot for code generation, pull-request review and conversational exploration of codebases, with human review of suggested changes.
Apply advanced prompt engineering and stay current with new AI models and their capabilities.

Build reproducible benchmarks for local LLMs across model families and sizes, evaluating structured-output reliability, relevance, grounding, latency and resource use to select models for production workflows.
Use AI credits responsibly, optimizing prompts and workflows to minimize credit consumption without compromising quality or human verification.
Understand LLM and RAG pipeline concepts; have built RAG pipelines using Hugging Face, Ollama, LangChain and ChromaDB.

bullets: Building a global ML platform for sales forecasting at the lowest level of granularity, using Python and PySpark (Apache Spark) on Azure Databricks. Develop forecasting workflows that apply market-specific rule sets within a common global solution.

Responsible for China market-specific forecasting requirements while building reusable capabilities for the global platform. Partner with planning, supply-chain and commercial stakeholders to translate market needs into production workflows.
Use Databricks notebooks, pipelines, jobs, Unity Catalog and compute to develop and run forecasting workflows; work with Delta Lake on Databricks and SQL Server on Azure.
Track the ML lifecycle in MLflow, from experiments through production use.
Work with scikit-learn and XGBoost models in production.
Run performance tests and tune Spark workloads and resource allocation to improve scalability and production reliability.
Serve as a GitHub code owner, perform final pull-request reviews and approvals, and coordinate monthly code releases.
Delivered ML and data-engineering work for multinational clients in agile teams, across rapid prototyping, production model serving and cloud data migration.
Rapidly prototyped an MVP for forecasting global vaccine needs using available data during a one-month project, for presentation to the client.
Developed live API-based recommender models and connected batch inference services over two years; iterated on models and feature engineering with MLflow lifecycle and experiment tracking.
Used Apache Airflow to schedule batch model inference and data pipelines.
Used GitHub Actions for ML CI/CD, including model training and deployment.
Deployed API-based and batch inference model services using BentoML and Docker containers, running on Kubernetes with infrastructure-as-code-based configuration.
Built live feature-engineering pipelines using Spark Streaming and Kafka; worked primarily in Python with some Scala.
Supported production services to meet SLOs and SLAs, benchmarked live model serving, and performance-tested and tuned Spark workloads and resource allocation.
Tracked A/B experiments and introduced model upgrades gradually.

Migrated data pipelines from legacy on-premises systems to the cloud during a six-month project; performed data and feature engineering in Python and used SQL Server DDL and DML for database management.
Developed embedded microprocessor software in C and PC applications in C++ for projects across different domains within a startup incubator.
Built time-critical actuator-control and server-based data-collection solutions, along with data storage and visualization tools.

Supported startups end to end, working on complete hardware and software solutions from PCB design through PC applications. Collaborated with founders and domain experts to turn early-stage ideas into working products.
Progressed from Junior Software Engineer to Software Engineer with increasing responsibility for architecture, implementation and delivery.
